title: Require and lock a draft
prompt: The supplied `Draft` is `{ title?: string; body?: string }`. Define `Final` with the same fields, both required. Then define `Locked` as a `Final` whose fields cannot be reassigned. Only the types are checked.
hints: Which utility type stops fields from being reassigned?
rejects: const l: Locked = { title: "a", body: "b" }; l.title = "c";

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps the fields optional, so a final draft can miss its body.

witness.detail: This should be a type error, but it compiles: const f: Final
This should be a type error, but it compiles: const l: Locked
